test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
concept: Modern India (National Movement ), Committees and Recommendation
question: Which committee was set up by Lord Chelmsford to enquire into Jallianwala Bagh incident in 1919?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hunter Committee.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Jallianwala Bagh massacre**, also known as the Amritsar massacre, took place on 13 April 1919.
 
• A large peaceful crowd had gathered at the Jallianwala Bagh in Amritsar, Punjab to protest against the arrest of pro-Indian independence leaders **Dr. Saifuddin Kitchlew** and **Dr. Satya Pal.**
 
• To punish people for their **'disobedience,**' British **Brigadier-General Reginald Dyer** ordered the army to fire into a crowd of thousands of unarmed Indians who had gathered to celebrate the** Baisakhi festival**, unknowing of the order.
 
• The colonial troops entered **Jallianwala Bagh in Amritsar, Punjab**, and shut the main entrance behind them so no one could evacuate before firing on the mob for around** ten minutes.**
 
• While the British government reported that about **350 persons** were slain in the massacre, the Congress party alleged that the number could have been as high as **1,000.**
 
• The** Jallianwala Bagh Tragedy** was investigated by the** 7-member Hunter Committee,** which was also known as the** Disorders Inquiry Committee. **
 
• The **Hunter Report** criticised most of General Dyer's choices, although it **backed **the implementation of martial law in Punjab.
 
• It also chastised** Gandhi's Satyagraha strategy** and held him partially accountable for the **"deteriorating" **law and order situation.
 
• The result was that **Dyer was sent to England**, relieved of his command.
 
• This miffed Gandhi and he returned the **Kaisar-i-Hind Gold medal.**
 
• As a result, the Indian National Congress teamed up with** Khilafat leaders**, and in the aftermath of resurgent** Hindu-Muslim solidarity,** Gandhi proposed a statewide **non-cooperation campaign** with the goal of achieving** full Swaraj.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Maclagan Committee - **The Maclagan Committee of 1915 was appointed to review the performance of cooperative societies and suggest measures for strengthening them. The committee observed that such institutions were eminently suited to cater to the needs of the lower and middle-income strata of society and would inculcate the principles of banking amongst the middle classes.
 
• **Harshell Committee** - It was formed in 1893 to give suggestions regarding currency.
 
• **Muddiman Committee** - The British Government had set up a committee under Sir Alexander Muddiman to meet the demand of the Indian Leaders and in view of the resolution adopted by the Swaraj Party in the early 1920s.It also recommended the appointment of a Royal Commission. The Committee consisted of four Indian members other than British members.
